proposals.before: In the intercalary third month of the fourth year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate Office reported: "Pursuant to an edict to examine jointly the gate regulations submitted by Gate Commissioner Li Duankai, when chief counselors and imperial princes form ranks and take their seats, each side has its own head of rank; chief counselors and commissioners of military affairs who hold the commissioner rank, or who hold both a commandery prince title and commissioner rank in one row, together constitute the Central Secretariat and Gate Office rank.
proposals.after: In the intercalary third month of the fourth year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate Office reported: "Pursuant to an edict to examine jointly the gate regulations submitted by Gate Commissioner Li Duanque, when chief counselors and imperial princes form ranks and take their seats, each side has its own head of rank; chief counselors and commissioners of military affairs who hold the commissioner rank, or who hold both a commandery prince title and commissioner rank in one row, together constitute the Central Secretariat and Gate Office rank.
proposals.reason: Chinese 端愨 is Duanque (愨 què), not Duankai; the personal name is mistranscribed.

decisions.reason: 舒王元偁 uses 偁 (chēng); Yuancheng matches the graph, while Yuanzheng invents a wrong given-name reading.
The literal likewise misreads 元偁 as Yuanzheng; Yuancheng is the correct romanization of 偁.
閣門使李端愨 has 愨 (què); Duanque is correct, and Duankai is a mistranscription of the given name.
The literal repeats Li Duankai for 李端愨; replacing with Li Duanque restores the correct reading of 愨.
宰臣呂大防 is Lü Dafang (防 fáng); Dagong invents a wrong second character reading.
The literal likewise has Lü Dagong for 呂大防; Lü Dafang matches 防.
宜令尚書省 names the Department of State Affairs; Ministry of Personnel would be 吏部, so the original office translation is wrong.
The literal has the same error: 尚書省 is Department of State Affairs, not Ministry of Personnel.
